name: ica-sudan-2018-flood-risk-2013
notes:
This layer contains information about the flood risk - by second-level administrative area - estimated during the Integrated Context Analysis (ICA) run in Sudan in 2018.
Data sources: UNEP/UNISDR, GAR 2013.
The main indicators used for the analysis were the percentage of district surface at flood risk and the maximum expected frequency of flood events with a 100-year return period.
